name: Checkpoint context pointers resolved by brief
aliases: context store pointer open item source resolved evidence brief
summary: Parses ten lowercase KIND:VALUE tokens inside existing checkpoint source/evidence strings without changing schema or bytes. CLI unresolved.items and HTTP checkpoint.open_items remain verbatim carry-safe; resolution is in separate maps keyed by item id. No new I/O; prose and unloaded kinds build no index. Five states: live means existence only; superseded marks explicit retirement/replacement; unavailable covers absent, inaccessible, malformed, conflicted, ambiguous, and task/comment anchor or hidden-record-comment targets; unloaded kinds uniformly unchecked; excess tokens unresolved (10/item,50/brief). Labels escape controls/direction marks before safe clipping120, with trust:data; text view folds line breaks. Old writers carry the same strings unchanged. Punctuation is literal, not stripped.
